text: ERGOT, in farriers, is a flub, like a piece of loft horn, about the biguns of a chefut, placed behind and be low the pattern join, and commonly hide under the tufi of the fetlock.

parsed.faithful: ERGOT, in farriery, is a ftub, like a piece of fott horn, about the bigness of a cheftnut, placed behind and below the pattern-joint, and commonly hid under the tuft of the fetlock.
parsed.modern: ERGOT, in farriery, is a stub, like a piece of soft horn, about the bigness of a chestnut, placed behind and below the pattern-joint, and commonly hid under the tuft of the fetlock.
